items.title_en: AI chip rout sends Korea's Kospi down 7.6%
items.title_zh: AI芯片股暴跌，韩国综指单日重挫7.6%
items.search_zh: 韩国股市暴跌 AI芯片
items.summary_en: Asian technology stocks suffered a brutal sell-off on Thursday, with South Korea's Kospi index plunging 7.57% to 5,554.22, its lowest close in six months. Trading in Seoul was briefly halted after the fall triggered a circuit breaker, and chip giants SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics each lost around 10%. Investors were rattled by sticky US inflation, which rose to 3.7% in September and raised bets that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates again. Higher borrowing costs have also revived doubts about whether the huge spending on AI infrastructure is sustainable.
items.summary_zh: 周四亚洲科技股遭遇猛烈抛售，韩国KOSPI综合指数暴跌7.57%，收于5554.22点，创六个月来最低收盘。跌幅触发熔断机制，首尔股市一度暂停交易，芯片巨头SK海力士和三星电子各跌约10%。美国9月通胀升至3.7%且居高不下，市场押注美联储将再次加息，令投资者恐慌。借贷成本上升也让人再度怀疑AI基础设施的巨额投入能否持续。
items.why_zh: AI概念是今年全球股市的主线，这次暴跌说明“AI泡沫”担忧正在升温，也会影响澳洲科技股和你的养老金（super）投资表现。

vocab.example: Trading in Seoul was briefly halted after the fall triggered a circuit breaker, and chip giants SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics each lost around 10%.
Higher borrowing costs have also revived doubts about whether the huge spending on AI infrastructure is sustainable.

explain.one_liner: 美国通胀降不下来，大家担心美国还要加息、AI 投资过热，于是亚洲芯片股被大量抛售，韩国股市一天跌了 7.6%。

facts.name: Kospi
facts.text: 韩国股市的大盘指数，类似澳洲的 ASX 200。

facts.name: 熔断 circuit breaker
facts.text: 股价跌得太快时，交易所暂停交易一会儿，让市场冷静。

facts.name: 美联储 the Fed
facts.text: 美国的央行，决定美国利率。利率高 → 借钱贵 → 股市通常会跌。

facts.name: AI 芯片股
facts.text: SK 海力士、三星给 AI 做芯片，这两年涨了很多，所以对坏消息特别敏感。

relations.b: 怀疑 AI 投资撑不住 → 芯片股被抛售
relations.label: 导致

points: 韩国 Kospi 跌 7.57%，收在 5,554 点，是六个月来最低。
跌幅触发熔断，首尔股市一度暂停交易。
SK 海力士和三星电子各跌约 10%。
explain.relevance: 澳洲的养老金（super）很多投在全球股票里，科技股大跌会影响你的 super 余额；市场情绪差时，客户的营销预算也常常会收紧。

items.title_en: Australian unemployment hits five-year high of 4.7%
items.title_zh: 澳洲失业率升至4.7%，创五年新高
items.summary_en: Australia's unemployment rate rose to 4.7% in September, its highest level since the end of the COVID lockdowns in October 2021, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics. The economy shed about 39,300 jobs, even though economists had expected it to add around 20,000. The decline was driven by a sharp drop in part-time work, which more than offset a rise in full-time jobs. The weak figures came just two weeks after the Reserve Bank lifted the cash rate to 4.60% in an effort to bring down stubborn inflation.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚统计局数据显示，9月澳洲失业率升至4.7%，为2021年10月新冠封锁结束以来的最高水平。经济学家原本预计新增约2万个就业岗位，结果却减少了约3.93万个。下降主要来自兼职岗位大幅减少，抵消了全职岗位的增长还有余。这份疲弱数据公布时，距离澳洲储备银行把现金利率上调至4.60%以对抗顽固通胀仅过去两周。
items.why_zh: 失业率和利率直接影响房贷、找工作和企业营销预算；兼职岗位减少也意味着消费者可能更“抠门”，做营销要更重视性价比。

vocab.example: The decline was driven by a sharp drop in part-time work, which more than offset a rise in full-time jobs.
The weak figures came just two weeks after the Reserve Bank lifted the cash rate to 4.60% in an effort to bring down stubborn inflation.

explain.one_liner: 9 月澳洲找不到工作的人变多了，失业率 4.7% 是近五年最高，而央行两周前刚加过息。

facts.name: 失业率
facts.text: 想工作却找不到工作的人占比。

facts.name: 澳储行 RBA
facts.text: 澳洲的央行，决定现金利率（cash rate），直接影响房贷利率。

facts.name: 通胀
facts.text: 物价涨得太快。央行加息就是为了把物价压下来。

facts.name: 为什么矛盾
facts.text: 加息能压物价，但也会让企业少招人。这次数据说明经济可能在变冷。

relations.b: 央行再加息的可能变小
relations.label: 可能导致

points: 失业率升到 4.7%，是 2021 年 10 月以来最高。
经济学家原本预计新增约 2 万个工作，结果反而少了约 3.9 万个。
减少的主要是兼职工作，全职其实还多了一些。
explain.relevance: 找工作或换工作的话，现在的就业市场在变冷；有房贷的话，失业率上升可能让央行暂停加息。

items.title_en: Zhou Xun wins top acting prize at Busan film festival
items.title_zh: 周迅凭《初次尝到寂寞》获釜山电影节表演奖
items.summary_en: Chinese actress Zhou Xun has won the Best Actor prize, a gender-neutral award, at the 31st Busan International Film Festival for her role in "The First Taste of Loneliness". The film, directed by Gu Xiaogang, also known as Gu You, is the final chapter of his acclaimed "Landscape" trilogy, which began with "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains". Zhou plays Yue, a middle-aged woman who returns home after her father dies and discovers that her mother has started a late-life romance. Chinese media celebrated the win as her first acting award from a major international competitive festival, and it became one of the hottest topics on Weibo.
items.summary_zh: 中国女演员周迅凭借电影《初次尝到寂寞》，获得第31届釜山国际电影节主竞赛单元的表演奖（该奖项不分性别，中文媒体称其为“影后”）。影片由顾晓刚（又名顾游）执导，是他广受好评的“山水”三部曲的最终章，系列第一部是《春江水暖》。周迅在片中饰演中年女性江月，父亲去世后她回乡整理遗物，却发现母亲开始了一段黄昏恋。中文媒体称这是她首个国际A类竞赛电影节的表演奖，相关话题迅速登上微博热搜。
items.why_zh: 华语电影和演员在亚洲最大电影节上获认可，“文艺片+实力派”话题也展示了口碑营销如何带动社交媒体热度。
items.source: The Paper (澎湃新闻); Busan International Film Festival
